    Bug 2052428 - Set test IMAP server default uidnext to 5000 instead of 1. r=darktrojan
    
    The idea being to show up tests that assume UIDs always start at 1.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D313110

diff --git a/mailnews/test/fakeserver/Imapd.sys.mjs b/mailnews/test/fakeserver/Imapd.sys.mjs
index 52deedcf3cc..93088441bf1 100644
--- a/mailnews/test/fakeserver/Imapd.sys.mjs
+++ b/mailnews/test/fakeserver/Imapd.sys.mjs
@@ -296,7 +296,7 @@ export class ImapMailbox {
     this.setDefault("delimiter", "/");
     this.setDefault("flags", []);
     this.setDefault("specialUseFlag", "");
-    this.setDefault("uidnext", 1);
+    this.setDefault("uidnext", 5000);
     this.setDefault("msgflags", [
       "\\Seen",
       "\\Answered",
